functions: Dates
FinancialMonthλ
Numbers each date's month within its financial year, from 1 to 12

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  FinancialMonthλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Numbers each date's month within its financial year, so July is month 1 when the year starts on 1 July*/

FinancialMonthλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Dates],
    [StartMonth],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →FinancialMonthλ(Dates, [StartMonth])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Numbers each date's month within its financial year, from 1 to 12.¶" &
                            "NOTES!         →With the default 1 July start, July is month 1 and June is month 12.¶               →Dates may be one date or a range, and the result takes their shape.¶               →FinancialYearλ() labels the year and FinancialQuarterλ() the quarter.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →20 Oct 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Dates          →(Required) One or more dates, numeric or text. A blank cell returns a blank.¶" &
                            "StartMonth     →(Optional: Default = 7) Month the financial year starts, a whole number from 1 to 12. Blank cells and empty text use 7.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.FinancialMonthλ(DATE(2026,8,15))¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→2",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          ISOMITTED(Dates),
    //  Set defaults
        FYStart,        IF(ISOMITTED(StartMonth), 7, IF(StartMonth = "", 7, StartMonth)),
        ValidStart?,    AND(IFERROR(OR(FYStart = SEQUENCE(12)), FALSE)),
        StartMessage,   "FinancialMonthλ needs StartMonth to be a whole number from 1 to 12.",
    //  Check inputs - apply convenience conversions. A blank cell stays blank, a text date is read
        CvtDates,       IF( ISOMITTED( Dates),
                            FALSE,
                            IF( ISNUMBER( Dates), Dates, IF( Dates = "", 0, DATEVALUE( Dates)))
                        ),
        Result,         IF(CvtDates = 0, "", MOD(MONTH(CvtDates) - FYStart, 12) + 1),
    //  Return Result, Help or the message
        Return,         IF(Help?, 2, IF(ValidStart?, 1, 3)),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, StartMessage)
    )
);

FinancialQuarterλ
Numbers each date's quarter within its financial year, from 1 to 4

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  FinancialQuarterλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Numbers each date's quarter within its financial year, so July to September is quarter 1 when the year starts on 1 July*/

FinancialQuarterλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Dates],
    [StartMonth],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →FinancialQuarterλ(Dates, [StartMonth])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Numbers each date's quarter within its financial year, from 1 to 4.¶" &
                            "NOTES!         →Each quarter is 3 months counted from StartMonth. With the default 1 July¶               →start, July to September is quarter 1 and April to June is quarter 4.¶               →Dates may be one date or a range, and the result takes their shape.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →20 Oct 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Dates          →(Required) One or more dates, numeric or text. A blank cell returns a blank.¶" &
                            "StartMonth     →(Optional: Default = 7) Month the financial year starts, a whole number from 1 to 12. Blank cells and empty text use 7.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.FinancialQuarterλ(DATE(2026,11,15))¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→2",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          ISOMITTED(Dates),
    //  Set defaults
        FYStart,        IF(ISOMITTED(StartMonth), 7, IF(StartMonth = "", 7, StartMonth)),
        ValidStart?,    AND(IFERROR(OR(FYStart = SEQUENCE(12)), FALSE)),
        StartMessage,   "FinancialQuarterλ needs StartMonth to be a whole number from 1 to 12.",
    //  Check inputs - apply convenience conversions. A blank cell stays blank, a text date is read
        CvtDates,       IF( ISOMITTED( Dates),
                            FALSE,
                            IF( ISNUMBER( Dates), Dates, IF( Dates = "", 0, DATEVALUE( Dates)))
                        ),
        Result,         IF(CvtDates = 0, "", INT(MOD(MONTH(CvtDates) - FYStart, 12) / 3) + 1),
    //  Return Result, Help or the message
        Return,         IF(Help?, 2, IF(ValidStart?, 1, 3)),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, StartMessage)
    )
);

YearToDateλ
Totals each row from the start of the financial year to an as-at date

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  YearToDateλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Totals each row of values from the start of the financial year to an as-at date*/

YearToDateλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Values],
    [Dates],
    [AsAt],
    [StartMonth],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →YearToDateλ(Values, Dates, AsAt, [StartMonth])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Totals each row of Values from the start of AsAt's financial year to AsAt.¶" &
                            "NOTES!         →A column counts when its date is on or after the first day of the financial¶               →year that contains AsAt, and on or before AsAt. Date each column by the first¶               →day of its period, or by its last day and an AsAt at a period end. Values must¶               →be numbers or blank cells; text, including the empty text a formula can return,¶               →gives #VALUE!. The result is one total for each row of Values.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →20 Oct 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Values         →(Required) A row or block of amounts, one column for each date in Dates.¶" &
                            "Dates          →(Required) A row of dates, one for each column of Values.¶" &
                            "AsAt           →(Required) The one date the total runs to, inclusive.¶" &
                            "StartMonth     →(Optional: Default = 7) Month the financial year starts, a whole number from 1 to 12. Blank cells and empty text use 7.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.YearToDateλ({10,20,30,40;1,2,3,4}, DATE(2026,{5,6,7,8},1), DATE(2026,8,31))¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→70, 7",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR(ISOMITTED(Values), ISOMITTED(Dates), ISOMITTED(AsAt)),
    //  Set defaults
        FYStart,        IF(ISOMITTED(StartMonth), 7, IF(StartMonth = "", 7, StartMonth)),
        ValidStart?,    AND(IFERROR(OR(FYStart = SEQUENCE(12)), FALSE)),
        Shaped?,        AND(ROWS(Dates) = 1, COLUMNS(Dates) = COLUMNS(Values), ISNUMBER(Dates)),
        OneDate?,       AND(ROWS(AsAt) = 1, COLUMNS(AsAt) = 1, ISNUMBER(AsAt)),
        StartMessage,   "YearToDateλ needs StartMonth to be a whole number from 1 to 12.",
        ShapeMessage,   "YearToDateλ needs Dates to be one row with a date for each column of Values.",
        AsAtMessage,    "YearToDateλ needs AsAt to be one date.",
    //  The first day of the financial year that contains AsAt
        YearStart,      DATE(YEAR(AsAt) - (MONTH(AsAt) < FYStart), FYStart, 1),
        InYear,         (Dates >= YearStart) * (Dates <= AsAt),
        Result,         MMULT(Values * 1, TRANSPOSE(InYear)),
    //  Return Result, Help or the message
        Return,         IF(Help?, 2, IF(NOT(ValidStart?), 3, IF(NOT(Shaped?), 4, IF(NOT(OneDate?), 5, 1)))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, StartMessage, ShapeMessage, AsAtMessage)
    )
);
